about: Cycle years and election day for the states whose towns vote on a multi-year cycle, as an anchor year plus a period in years (a year is a cycle year when (year - anchorYear) is a multiple of periodYears). Read by src/core2/elections-calendar.ts. Citations are the corpus rows data/municipal-elections/92O-national-state-baseline.json (secondary-synthesis-only). Only AL and MS use a cycle timing (checked over all 56 rows).

US-AL.citation: Ala. Code sec. 11-46-21: fourth Tuesday in August every 4 years (2020, 2024, 2028)

US-MS.citation: Miss. Code secs. 21-11-7, 21-11-11: general election the first Tuesday after the first Monday in June every 4 years (2021, 2025, 2029)
